---
title: "7. Write the report: Your own study"
---

## Create your report

From the main project folder:

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/create_report.R my-study
```

This creates `reports/my-study-report.qmd` if it does not already exist. Existing
writing is kept. The draft includes exploration figures, with inference plots
included only when the corresponding completed outputs exist at creation.

## Replace prompts with evidence

Use your notes from the preceding steps. State the question, sample unit,
input source, group sizes, reference/comparison, settings and exclusions.
Choose the most informative figures for the main result and retain the rest
as supporting evidence. For tests, record model and uncertainty, not only
which p-values passed a threshold.

Read [Write a report you can defend](../../02-write-the-report.qmd).
Do not leave template instructions in the submitted report. State how AI
helped and which checks you performed.

## Render and inspect

```bash
cd reports
quarto render my-study-report.qmd --to html
cd ..
```

Open the HTML file printed by Quarto. Confirm images load and every number,
contrast and limitation matches your current complete run. Rendering uses
existing results; it does not rerun analysis.

Your report stays in ignored `reports/`, separate from the published guide.
